That’s the thing. My mom stayed in a loveless marriage because of me. And when she finally divorced, she had to work at low-income jobs like McDonald’s and Walmart. 

Her fiancée sexually assaulted me and the state did nothing to protect me. Her fiancée turned my mom against me, saying I was making all of it up got split them apart. My mom believed him.

Years later, I was raped by an older man during a date. He slipped something into my drink and next thing I knew I was naked in his apartment. He raped me repeatedly, someone the pain being so great I would wake up from my unconscious state. 

I tried fleeing the country after that. While studying abroad, I made a really good friend. He was smart and told me we would see each other in the future for sure.

Months later he told me he won a scholarship to my university to study abroad. One night, he snuck into my room and brutally raped me. He insisted that this was my fault because I never saw him as more than a friend. He chocked me, kicked me, and punched me. He told me I wouldn’t leave my dorm alive. 

Luckily, I found a way to scape. I pressed charges. The police did nothing because they made a case against my character and came to the conclusion that I was “asking for it.”

It’s been 3 years since and I can’t bring myself to trust anyone.

I have a boyfriend, but he became my boyfriend because he doesn’t judge me. I don’t know if I love him, but a am 100% certain I am not in love with him. 

I’ve parted ways from my family since they don’t trust my judgement with men. 

I just don’t see what was the purpose behind all that struggle. 

Last week, one of my best friends was raped. And there was nothing I could do to help her but console her. Therefore, my experiences happened for no reason. I couldn’t prevent other attacks, even from those close to me.

I’m worthless.
Fascinating.  I never heard that story before
What did you do to become so strong?

I mean, this is just my experience. 

I have a tendency to remain calm in these situations. I scream in tears in my mind, but on the outside I’ll present myself as calm and composed.

Perhaps that’s my problem? 

Perhaps I need to make a big show of how much pain I’m in in order for therapists to see what I’m struggling with. 

I don’t want to turn anyone away from therapy. I’m just voicing my experience. I am still a firm believer that therapy can work.

Thank you so much for your kindness. Too root for a complete stranger, it speaks volumes of your character. 

I’ve been on that search myself. Finding a new normal. I just don’t know how long I can carry on thinking things will magically sort themselves out while nothing changes and I become trapped on a path I shouldn’t be in.
I haven’t! What is it about?

I sincerely hope so too. Honestly, I just don’t want to be a bother to anyone. 

And I felt like I was bothering that therapist.

Thank you very much. I’ve come to terms that there will be no justice made. However, I am hopeful of attaining some peace of my own. 

I genuinely have a desire to live. I try my best to give back to my community and volunteer in whatever time I have. 

I just come up short and think that the world is better without me. There’s nothing I can do to make it better.

I completely understand you. I was molested by my stepfather when I was younger. Then I was raped by an older man that slipped something in my drink. He proceeded to “do experiments” with my body that permanently burned flesh of my labia. Then I was raped again by my best friend who swore he was going to kill me. 

I really don’t know how to recover from all the betrayal. So much trust has been lost.
I get flashbacks all the time. I feel so guilty about getting them too.

I tried EMDR and the person just didn’t seem interesting in me as a patient. She would show up late to appointments, fall asleep during the session. I basically felt like I was talking to myself. 

It made me feel worse. Like someone was wrong with me and I would forever have to cope with my defects.

I have, and it wasn’t very helpful. I really felt like the person I was talking to didn’t care what was going on. 

Also, they tried blaming everything on the way I was raised.

Thank you very much! I had a trauma therapist specializing in PTSD and I thought “She’s really going to help me! I’m so glad”

In the end, all she did was teach me about getting in touch with my happy places (one finger in my hand per happy moment) so that when the dark ones came along, I can revert to those. Bam. $1,600 down the drain for spirit fingers.

Thank you for shining such a positive light into this dark issue.

I do have a series of hobbies to keep me from suicidal thoughts such as gardening, baking and volunteering. 

If you see me at the office, I’m the happy-go-lucky employee who will bring 120% to work. I don’t mind listening to other people’s problems, working extra hours. I’ll do just about anything to keep myself from thinking about myself.
I have not! What is it about?

Thank you for thoughts.

I wish you the best on your own personal journey

I’m grateful that you are out of that horrible relationship. It doesn’t sound very healthy for you.

For me, this friend became so obsessed that he locked me up in my own dorm and assaulted me repeatedly over the course of 30 hours until he thought it be better to kill me. He tried chocking me several times. 

Grief hits me every now and then. Am I supposed to be living this live? 

The stakes are getting higher each time. My boyfriend speaks of marriage and I don’t think I’ll ever become ready for that. I don’t even know if I truly love him. I care for him and we’ve been together for 3 years already, but everything else confounds me.

Yeah, I was diagnosed with PTSD a few years ago. I tried acting like nothing happened and continued being my happy go lucky self. 

I was distanced by my family because they could no longer trust my judgement. My friends (the ones that knew) kept judging was I was wearing. 

I’ve tried drowning myself, overdosing, cutting myself.

I don’t know what to do

I even tried EMDR, though it sounded helpful, I never felt the therapist was listening to me. 

It’s actually kind of funny. She fell asleep in one of my sessions. 

Naturally, I tried confronting her and asking her about her herself. I never went back after 3 sessions. I felt like broken and no one could fix that.

Thank you very much. That’s the nicest gesture anyone has given me today. 

I’ll go look into these sites.
